faqs.q: What are Finned Tube Support Collars used for?
faqs.a: Finned tube support collars fit round the fins at each tube support of an air cooler or heater, so the weight and vibration of the tube do not crush the fins where it rests.

faqs.q: What sizes can Finned Tube Support Collars be supplied in?
faqs.a: Finned Tube Support Collars can be supplied in the size you need (Made to the fin OD and your drawing). Tell us the size or capacity you need, and the application, through the enquiry and we confirm the dimensions and the part number with the quotation.

faqs.q: How are Finned Tube Support Collars sized, and what do I send to get them quoted?
faqs.a: For Finned Tube Support Collars, each collar is sized to the fin outside diameter of the finned tube it carries, and to the tube pitch. Send the bundle drawing, or the tube OD, fin OD and fin type, with the tube pitch and layout and the number of supports per tube and tubes.

faqs.q: What load and temperature can Finned Tube Support Collars take?
faqs.a: For Finned Tube Support Collars, support collars carry the weight of the finned tube and spread it over the support, so no load rating is published. The collar is made to the fin outside diameter and the drawing, and the material is chosen for the service temperature and the plant atmosphere.

faqs.q: What materials are Finned Tube Support Collars made in?
faqs.a: For Finned Tube Support Collars, collars are quoted in aluminium, galvanised carbon steel or stainless steel, chosen for the service temperature and the plant atmosphere, with stainless used where the air is humid or salty.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Finned Tube Support Collars?
faqs.a: The listing gives the documentation for Finned Tube Support Collars as: mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. The bore and fit are checked against the fin outside diameter before dispatch. Tell us if your inspection plan needs more.

faqs.q: What do Finned Tube Support Collars connect to or work with?
faqs.a: For Finned Tube Support Collars, a collar fits round the fins at each support point of an air-cooler bundle and holds the tube on its pitch while still letting it move as it expands. For the supports in shell-and-tube exchangers see [heat exchanger baffles and support plates](/p/heat-exchanger-baffles-and-support-plates).

faqs.q: When do Finned Tube Support Collars need replacing?
faqs.a: For Finned Tube Support Collars, collars are replaced on their own when the fins have been crushed or worn at the supports, which shows as damaged fins at each support and tubes that sag or rattle between them. For a retrofit, send a photograph of the existing collar with the tube and fin dimensions and we match it.

faqs.q: Where are Finned Tube Support Collars used?
faqs.a: For Finned Tube Support Collars, finned tube support collars are used in air-cooled heat exchangers, fired heaters and heat-recovery bundles.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to get a quotation for Finned Tube Support Collars?
faqs.a: For Finned Tube Support Collars, send the Indus part number from the size table, or the size and the load or duty you need, with the quantity and delivery country. Use [our contact page](/contact) and we reply with a price and lead time. Say on the RFQ if you need documents beyond the standard ones.

faqs.q: Can Finned Tube Support Collars be supplied to customers outside the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply Finned Tube Support Collars to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the delivery country and the drawing or data sheet through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Do you hold Finned Tube Support Collars in stock, or are they made to order?
faqs.a: Finned Tube Support Collars are made to your drawing or data sheet rather than held as catalogue stock, so the lead time is confirmed with the quotation. We quote from our office in Dubai, UAE, and supply worldwide; send the drawing or data sheet, the material and the quantity through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What are Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates used for?
faqs.a: Segmental baffles and tube support plates hold the tubes of a shell-and-tube exchanger on pitch and direct the shell-side flow, stack-drilled to TEMA hole clearances and your drawing.

faqs.q: What sizes can Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates be supplied in?
faqs.a: Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates can be supplied in the size you need (Made to your drawing; standard geometry in the description). Tell us the size or capacity you need, and the application, through the enquiry and we confirm the dimensions and the part number with the quotation.

faqs.q: How are Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates sized, and what do I send to get them quoted?
faqs.a: For Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates, they are made to your drawing, so there is no catalogue part number per size. Send the drawing, or the material, the outside diameter, the thickness, the tube size, the pitch and the layout, and we quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: What hole clearances and tolerances apply to Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates?
faqs.a: For Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates, the sizing limits come from the standard. The baffle tube hole is the tube OD plus 0.8 mm (1/32 in) when the unsupported span is 914 mm or less or the OD is over 31.8 mm, and the tube OD plus 0.4 mm (1/64 in) when the span is over 914 mm and the OD is 31.8 mm or less. On 96% of holes the over-tolerance is +0.010 in (0.25 mm), and +0.015 in on the other 4%.

faqs.q: Why not specify tighter holes in Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates than TEMA allows?
faqs.a: For Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates, specifying holes tighter than TEMA or HEI raises cost and risks tube damage at insertion. Zone design, larger entrance and exit areas, larger pitch or thicker baffles control vibration better than tighter holes.

faqs.q: How are Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates made?
faqs.a: For Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates, baffles and support plates are machined from plate or forging to your drawing, cut, drilled, reamed and grooved from certified plate or forgings, with burrs removed. The material grade follows your drawing and the mill certificate.

faqs.q: Which standards and checks apply to Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates?
faqs.a: Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates are made to TEMA and, for feedwater heaters, the HEI Standards for Closed Feedwater Heaters. Hole size is checked against the 96% / 4% rule, and a mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 is available on request with third-party inspection by arrangement.

faqs.q: What do Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates connect to or work with?
faqs.a: For Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates, baffles and support plates are stacked on the tubes of an exchanger bundle with the tube sheets and tie rods, so their hole pattern must match the tube sheet drilling. Finned-tube air coolers use [finned tube support collars](/p/finned-tube-support-collars) at their supports.

faqs.q: How are the holes in Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates drilled and checked?
faqs.a: For Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates, check hole size, pitch and ligaments against the drawing before dispatch; the holes are stack-drilled so they line up through the bundle, with stacks normally no deeper than 5 drill diameters. Our [Tube sheets and baffles: drilling, pitch and hole clearances](/blog/tube-sheet-drilling-pitch-baffle-holes) covers hole layout and clearances.

faqs.q: When are Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates ordered?
faqs.a: For Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates, replacement baffles and support plates are ordered during refinery and gas-plant retubing.

faqs.q: Can Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates be supplied to customers outside the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the delivery country and the drawing or data sheet through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Do you hold Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates in stock, or are they made to order?
faqs.a: Heat Exchanger Baffles and Support Plates are made to your drawing or data sheet rather than held as catalogue stock, so the lead time is confirmed with the quotation. We quote from our office in Dubai, UAE, and supply worldwide; send the drawing or data sheet, the material and the quantity through [our contact page](/contact).
